description: Run a skill's procedure (or steps that call its procedures) in the background, with no time limit: the stored steps replay and you are asked only where the skill leaves a decision open. action 'start' (sessionId, skill, procedure? default main, inputs?, steps?, frames?, version?; or launch: true to start the skill's environment for the run, keep? to keep it) starts it and waits up to waitMs (default 20000) for it to end or to need you. 'get' (runId, waitMs?) reads it; 'continue' (runId with values answering its question, or action 'retry' or 'skip', or steps to run instead of a stuck step) goes on; 'cancel' (runId); 'list' (skill?, status?). A run that needs you says so: needs_input with a question, or needs_help with the step that failed. Steps you give for a stuck step are kept as a proposed fix to the skill.

continueAction.description: For continue: run the stuck step again, or go on without it

frames.description: For start: coordinate frames the steps may name

keep.description: For start with launch: keep the capsule after the run

launch.description: For start: launch the skill's environment for the run

sessionId.description: For start: the capsule to run on

skill.description: For start or list: the skill's name

steps.description: For start: steps instead of a procedure; for continue: steps to run instead of the stuck step

values.description: For continue: the answer to the run's question

waitMs.description: How long to wait for the run to end or need you (default 20000 for start and continue)

name: capsulate_skill_run
title: Run a skill in the background
